deploybot: [migration-slot] Requesting 05/20 02:00-03:00 UTC for migration m-7420 (partial index + deferred FK validate backfill). Please ack in 10m or slot released. canaries=2.
Sam: Plan summary: create a partial shadow index targeting active users only, run chunked backfill workers, then do deferred FK validate in small batches. Final rename will use a brief ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock (~300ms). Throttle default=300 r/s.
Ivy: Heads-up: deferred validation means we keep constraint unvalidated until after swap, then validate in 5s batches to limit lock impact. If validation fails, revert to old index name and flag offending rows.
SRE-oncall: I'll enable autotune: if replica_lag > 20s for >90s throttle to 100 r/s; if lag >40s pause and page. Set pager cooldown and mute duplicate index_build alerts for 45m.
Peter: Please pin canaries to release-3.6.0-rc-db to avoid premature feature flags. Rollback plan: 1) abort before swap -> no user impact; 2) post-swap revert by renaming old index back (short lock); 3) if validation already started and fails, run targeted fix script.
ops-bot: Holdpoint created: manual-unpin required before global rollout. Preflight checks enabled (replica lag, long txs, validation dry-run).
Sam: Sanitized SQL snippet:
```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY users_active_email_shadow ON users ((lower(email))) WHERE active=true WITH (fillfactor=85);
-- chunked workers fill shadow index
-- swap: BEGIN; LOCK TABLE users IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; ALTER INDEX users_active_email_shadow RENAME TO users_active_email_idx; COMMIT;
-- deferred validate: VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk_users_accounts IN batches
```
Ivy: I'll run canary and smoke tests. If profile queries p95 > 250ms or validation error rate >0.5% we abort and revert.
SRE-oncall: Acked. I'll monitor p95/p99 latencies and replica lag, post go/no-go within 12m of canary.
Sam: Claiming slot now. deploybot: start canaries at 02:00 UTC and post status updates here.
deploybot: Slot claimed. Will post canary health and final decision in this thread.
